evidence.decision: Orders introduction, essential eligibility, informed consent and critical data access.
evidence.artifact: Requires onboarding/task/profile sequence with supplied study content distinguished from presentation.
evidence.transformation: Late ineligibility and launch permissions become early checks, navigable consent and relevant post-consent access.
evidence.verification: Fails premature permission, late eligibility, ambiguous completion and missing withdrawal/consent access.
evidence.applicability: Preserves iOS/iPad scope and explicitly separates ethics/legal/clinical measurement validity from UI work.
evidence.handoffs: HealthKit covers access, CareKit care plans and Writing clear study language.
evidence.distinctiveness: Consent whole-form review, survey progress and participant withdrawal make the workflow research-specific.
